svg.title: Behavioral Template Method - actual Stock classes

g.text: Behavioral Template Method - actual Stock classes
final workflow: actor -> active guard (409) -> delta -> nonnegative balance
Transaction belongs to StockService or Fulfillment, not the template.
Consumption uses processWithOrder final workflow; order_id / negative delta / unique order-stock audit.
Types: IN / ADJUSTMENT / CONSUMPTION. Adjustment uses signed delta.
openingTargetStock/active implemented by V15; shortfall = max(target - quantity, 0), derived, not persisted.
Manager-only item create/update/active; inactive item rejects stock-in/adjust with 409.
SKU and unit are locked once transactions exist; recipe/snapshot references also lock unit.
